name: Lily of the Valley
source:
"Mister… Are you a lonely person?"

Returning home to Wales for the first time in ten years to attend his mother’s funeral, a middle-aged man encounters a young girl he has never met before on a walk in the countryside. Although her face is often expressionless, her words harsh and cutting the man soon forges a friendship with her, of sorts, as he confides in her his worries. However, their every encounter leaves him with more questions. How did she know his departed mother? Why does she have such a morbid fascination with death? And why does she look so much like his childhood sweetheart?
translation:
“先生……你是孤独的人吗？”

一名中年男子时隔十年首次回到威尔士，参加母亲的葬礼。他在乡间散步时遇到一个从未见过的小女孩。女孩脸上常常毫无表情，说话尖刻刺耳，但男子向她倾诉烦恼后，两人逐渐建立起某种友谊。然而，每次相遇都会留下更多疑问。她怎么会认识已故的母亲？为什么她对死亡有着病态的迷恋？为什么她看起来那么像自己童年的恋人？
